questions.question: 英语简单句最基本的骨架是什么？
questions.explanation: 任何句子拆到不能再拆，都只剩下“主语 + 谓语”两个核心部分。

questions.question: “Papa rabbit teaches you English.” 属于哪一种基本句型？
questions.explanation: teaches 后有间接宾语 you（对谁）和直接宾语 English（给了什么），是双及物句型。

questions.question: “Papa rabbit considers you smart.” 中 smart 是什么成分？
questions.explanation: smart 补充说明宾语 you 是什么样子，是宾语补语。可用“you are smart”来检验。

questions.question: “The rabbit smells nice.” 中 smells 是？
questions.explanation: smells 在此把 nice 这个属性赋予主语，是系动词，后接表语。

questions.question: 句子成分中，“补充说明主语”的是哪一种成分？
questions.explanation: 主语补语（表语）出现在系动词后，补充说明主语的性质或身份。

questions.question: “The little white rabbit ate a large carrot.” 中 little white 是什么成分？
questions.explanation: little white 修饰名词 rabbit，作定语。

questions.question: 关于谓语和谓语动词的关系，正确的是？
options: 谓语动词是谓语的一部分
谓语是谓语动词的一部分
questions.explanation: 谓语包含动词及宾语补语状语等，谓语动词只是其中动词部分。如 has eaten a carrot 中 has eaten 是谓语动词，整句是谓语。

questions.question: 英语动词的“三大本领”不包括以下哪项？
questions.explanation: 时、体、气是三大本领；语态由 be + 过去分词表达，不属于“三大本领”范畴。

questions.question: “The rabbit has eaten a carrot.” 中谓语动词是？
questions.explanation: 助动词 has + 主动词 eaten 构成现在完成时，整个 has eaten 是谓语动词。

questions.question: 下列哪项是简单句？
options: The carrot is tasty and the rabbit ate it.
The rabbit ate the carrot that I bought.
Because it rained, he stayed home.
questions.explanation: 只有一套主谓结构的是简单句；其余分别含并列连词或从句，是复合句/复杂句。

questions.question: 系动词 be 的作用是？
options: 把后面的信息赋予主语
questions.explanation: be 本身没有具体动作，只是把表语承载的信息“赋予”主语。

questions.question: “The rabbit ate the carrot that I bought.” 属于？
questions.explanation: 含 that 引导的定语从句，是主从复合句（复杂句）。

questions.question: “The carrot is tasty and the rabbit ate it.” 属于？
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列分句，是并列复合句。

questions.question: 句子按用途分类，“What a tasty carrot!” 是？
questions.explanation: 以 What/How 开头、表强烈感情的句子是感叹句。

questions.question: “Did the rabbit eat the carrot?” 是哪种疑问句？
questions.explanation: 以助动词 Did 开头、用是/否回答的是一般疑问句。

questions.question: “The rabbit ate a carrot, didn't he?” 是？
questions.explanation: 陈述 + 简短反问结构，是反义疑问句。

questions.question: “I ate two carrots.” 中 two 是？
questions.explanation: two 表数量，是数词（此处修饰名词作定语）。

questions.question: “The rabbit runs quickly.” 中 quickly 修饰的是？
questions.explanation: quickly 修饰动词 runs，是副词作状语。

questions.question: “Call me a taxi.” 与 “Call me Papa.” 中 me 后的成分，正确的是？
questions.explanation: Call me a taxi 中 taxi 是直接宾语（间宾+直宾）；Call me Papa 中 Papa 是对 me 的称呼（宾补）。

questions.question: “I can eat three times faster than he can.” 中 three times 是？
questions.explanation: 倍数 + 比较级 + than 表“比…快三倍”。

questions.question: “The sun rises in the east.” 用一般现在时，因为？
questions.explanation: 客观真理/自然现象用一般现在时。

questions.question: “I have eaten breakfast.” 表？
options: 过去动作对现在有影响
questions.explanation: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响/结果。

questions.question: “He is reading a book now.” 用现在进行时，强调？
questions.explanation: 现在进行时表此刻正在进行的动作。

questions.question: 一般过去时“I ate a carrot.” 强调？
options: 过去某时做过这个动作
questions.explanation: 一般过去时只强调过去某时间点发生的动作，不涉及现在。

questions.question: “By the time he arrives, I will have finished.” 用将来完成时表？
questions.explanation: 将来完成时 will have done 表到将来某点之前已完成。

questions.question: “It seems that the rabbit is hungry.” 中 it 是？
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语，真正主语是后面的 that 从句。

questions.question: 动词的语态（主动/被动）是由什么表达的？
questions.explanation: 被动语态 = be + 过去分词。

questions.question: 与现在事实相反的条件句，if 从句用？
questions.explanation: 与现在相反，if 从句用过去式（were/did），主句用 would + 原形。

questions.question: “If I ___ a bird, I would fly.” 应填？
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气与现在事实相反，be 动词一律用 were（即使是 I）。

questions.question: 与过去事实相反，主句用？
questions.explanation: 与过去相反，if 从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

questions.question: “I wish I ___ taller.” 应填？
questions.explanation: wish 后接与现在事实相反的愿望，用过去式（were）。

questions.question: “The teacher suggested that he ___ harder.” 应填？
questions.explanation: suggest 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气（should）+ 动词原形，should 可省略。

questions.question: 非谓语动词（非限定动词）的特点不包括？
questions.explanation: 非谓语动词不能作谓语，只能作主语、宾语、补语、状语等。

questions.question: “She decided ___ abroad.” 应填？
questions.explanation: decide 后接不定式 to do 作宾语。

questions.question: “I enjoy ___ reading.” 应填？
questions.explanation: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语。

questions.question: “I had my car ___ yesterday.” 应填？
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + 过去分词，表示“让别人把车洗了”。

questions.question: make 的使役用法中，宾语后接？
questions.explanation: make + 宾语 + 动词原形（省略 to）。

questions.question: 不规则动词 eat 的过去分词是？
questions.explanation: eat → ate（过去式）→ eaten（过去分词），属 ABC 型。

questions.question: must 与 have to 的区别是？
options: must 表主观，have to 表客观
questions.explanation: must 出于主观认为，have to 出于客观情况迫使。mustn't 表禁止，don't have to 表不必。

questions.question: “You mustn't do it.” 的意思是？
questions.explanation: mustn't 表示“禁止、千万别”，语气强于 shouldn't。

questions.question: 独立主格“名词 + 现在分词”结构的作用是？
questions.explanation: 独立主格附着在主句上作状语，有自己的逻辑主语。

questions.question: 不规则动词 lie（躺）的过去式是？
questions.explanation: lie（躺）→ lay → lain；lay（放置）→ laid → laid，二者易混。

questions.question: 与将来事实可能相反的假设，if 从句可用？
questions.explanation: 与将来相反，if 从句可用 should + 原形或 were to + 原形。

questions.question: “If it had rained, we ___ at home.” 应填？
questions.explanation: 与过去事实相反的虚拟，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

questions.question: “He talks as if he ___ everything.” 应填？
questions.explanation: as if 后与事实相反的假想用虚拟语气（过去式 knew）。

questions.question: “It is time we ___ home.” 应填？
questions.explanation: It is time + 从句用过去式（虚拟），表示“该做…了”。

questions.question: “I would rather you ___ tomorrow.” 应填？
questions.explanation: would rather + 从句用过去式（虚拟），表示“宁愿你明天来”。

questions.question: 现在分词作定语表？
questions.explanation: 现在分词作定语表主动、进行；过去分词表被动、完成。

questions.question: “The story is interesting.” 中 interesting 表？
questions.explanation: 现在分词作表语暗含主动，表“令人感兴趣”。

questions.question: “The rabbit is interested in carrots.” 中 interested 表？
questions.explanation: 过去分词作表语暗含被动，表“对…感兴趣（被吸引）”。

questions.question: “I saw the rabbit cross the road.” 强调看到的是？
questions.explanation: 感官动词 + 裸不定式表看到全过程；+ doing 表看到正在进行的片段。

questions.question: “He must have finished it.” 表？
questions.explanation: must have done 表对过去的推测，几乎肯定已发生。

questions.question: “You should have told me earlier.” 表？
questions.explanation: should have done 表“本应该做却没做”，带责备/遗憾。

questions.question: “It is important ___ English.” 应填？
questions.explanation: It is + adj + to do，不定式作真正主语。

questions.question: “___ is believing.” 应填？
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语表一般性概念：Seeing is believing（眼见为实）。

questions.question: “I like ___ in summer.” 表达一般爱好，应填？
questions.explanation: like 后接动名词表一般性爱好。

questions.question: “She stopped ___ with me.” 表达“停下来跟我说话”，应填？
questions.explanation: stop to do 表“停下来去做”；stop doing 表“停止正在做的”。

questions.question: “Remember ___ the door.” 表达“记得要锁（还没锁）”，应填？
questions.explanation: remember to do 表记得要做（未发生）；remember doing 表记得做过。

questions.question: “I forgot ___ him before.” 表达“忘记见过（见过但忘了）”，应填？
questions.explanation: forget doing 表忘记曾做过（已发生）；forget to do 表忘记要做。

questions.question: “The window needs ___.” 应填？
questions.explanation: need 后接动名词主动形式表被动意义（need cleaning = need to be cleaned）。

questions.question: “I had my hair ___ yesterday.” 应填？
questions.explanation: have + 宾语 + 过去分词，让头发被剪，cut 的过去分词仍是 cut。

questions.question: The person ___ is standing there is my friend. 应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词指人且作从句主语，用 who。

questions.question: “___ it rains, we will stay home.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 表达“如果明天下雨”的条件，用 if。

questions.question: 定语从句中，先行词是“人 + 物”混合时，只能用？
questions.explanation: 先行词同时含人和物时，只能用 that。

questions.question: “The news that the rabbit won spread fast.” 中 that 从句是？
questions.explanation: that 从句跟在抽象名词 news 后，说明其内容，是同位语从句（that 在从句中不作成分）。

questions.question: “The fact is ___ the rabbit ate the carrot.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: that 从句在 is 后作表语，是表语从句。

questions.question: “I don't know ___ he will come.” 表达“是否”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 宾语从句表达“是否”用 whether / if。

questions.question: “___ I get home, I will call you.” 表达“当…时”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 时间状语从句表达“当我到家时”用 when；注意主句将来时，when 从句用一般现在时。

questions.question: “You will fail ___ you work hard.” 表达“除非”，应填入？
questions.explanation: unless = if not，表达“除非你努力否则会失败”。

questions.question: 非限定性定语从句（带逗号）中，指物只能用？
questions.explanation: 非限定性定语从句指物只能用 which，不能用 that。

questions.question: “This is the reason ___ the rabbit ate the carrot.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: reason 后接 why 引导定语从句，why = for which。

questions.question: “___ the weather permits, we will go out.” 表达“如果”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 条件状语从句表达“如果天气允许”用 if。

questions.question: “He is smarter than I ___.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: than 比较状语从句中补全主语谓语，I 用 am。

questions.question: “This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.” 指物且作宾语，应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词 book 指物，关系词作 bought 的宾语，用 which/that（可省略）。

questions.question: “The man ___ you met is my teacher.” 作宾语指人，应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人，关系词作 met 的宾语，用 who/whom（口语可省略）。

questions.question: “The teacher ___ son won the prize is my friend.” 表所属，应填入？
questions.explanation: son 属于 teacher，表所属关系用 whose。

questions.question: “All ___ I want is a carrot.” 先行词是不定代词，应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词是 all 等不定代词时，定语从句只能用 that。

questions.question: “This is the best carrot ___ I've ever eaten.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词被最高级 the best 修饰，定语从句用 that。

questions.question: “Whether the rabbit ate the carrot is obvious.” 中 Whether 从句是？
questions.explanation: Whether 从句位于谓语 is 之前作主语，是主语从句。

questions.question: “The problem is that the rabbit is hungry.” 中 that 从句是？
questions.explanation: that 从句在 is 后作表语，是表语从句。

questions.question: “I don't know where the rabbit ate the carrot.” 中 where 从句是？
questions.explanation: where 从句作 know 的宾语，是宾语从句。

questions.question: “Even if I see a carrot, I will not eat it.” 中 Even if 引导的是？
questions.explanation: even if 表“即使”，是让步状语从句。

questions.question: “As soon as the wolf stopped by, the rabbit ate.” 中 As soon as 引导？
questions.explanation: as soon as 表“一…就…”，是时间状语从句。

questions.question: “The house ___ roof is red is mine.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: roof 属于 house，表所属用 whose。

questions.question: “This is the reason ___ he left.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: reason 后接 why 引导定语从句。

questions.question: “I still remember the day ___ we met.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词 the day 表时间，从句缺时间状语，用 when。

questions.question: “The village ___ I grew up is far away.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 先行词 the village 表地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

questions.question: “___ you are here, we can start.” 表达“既然”，应填入？
questions.explanation: since 表“既然/因为”（已知原因，较委婉），从句在句首。

questions.question: “He ran fast ___ he could catch the bus.” 表达目的，应填入？
questions.explanation: so that 引导目的状语从句，表“以便”。

questions.question: “___ she was tired, she went on working.” 表达让步，应填入？
questions.explanation: although 表“虽然”，引导让步状语从句。

questions.question: “The rabbit ate the carrot ___ he found it.” 表地点，应填入？
questions.explanation: where 引导地点状语从句，表“在…地方”。

questions.question: “I think ___ he is right.” 宾语从句应填入？
questions.explanation: 宾语从句结构完整、表陈述事实，用 that（可省略）。

questions.question: 下列哪个词是可数名词？
questions.explanation: apple 有单复数变化，是可数名词；water/money/advice 为不可数名词。

questions.question: “This book is (我的)” 应填入哪个词？
questions.explanation: 作表语时需用名词性物主代词 mine（my 是形容词性物主代词，后需跟名词）。

questions.question: 形容词 “beautiful” 的比较级是？
questions.explanation: 多音节词用 more + 原级构成比较级：more beautiful。

questions.question: “___ university” 前应填 a 还是 an？
questions.explanation: university 以 /juː/ 开头（辅音音素），用 a 而非 an。

questions.question: “___ honest boy” 前应填？
questions.explanation: honest 的 h 不发音，以元音音素开头，用 an。

questions.question: “I'm interested ___ English.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be interested in（对…感兴趣）。

questions.question: “He works very ___.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: hard 本身可作副词表“努力地”；hardly 是“几乎不”。

questions.question: “friendly” 是形容词还是副词？
questions.explanation: friendly 以 -ly 结尾却是形容词，修饰名词，如 a friendly rabbit。

questions.question: “I have ___ friends in this city.” 表达“几个（肯定）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: a few + 可数复数表“有几个”（肯定）；few 表“几乎没有”（否定）。

questions.question: “The teacher and video creator ___ a rabbit.” 表达“一人两身份”，应填入？
questions.explanation: a teacher and video creator 指同一人（一个身份兼两个），谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: “___ moon” 前应填入？
questions.explanation: 独一无二的天体前用 the。

questions.question: “I saw a rabbit. ___ rabbit ran away.” 第二处应填入？
questions.explanation: 再次提及已经提过的名词，用 the。

questions.question: “play ___ piano” 前应填入？
questions.explanation: 乐器名词前用 the，表示弹奏这种乐器。

questions.question: “___ sun rises in the east.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 独一无二的天体（sun/moon/earth）前用 the。

questions.question: “I'm good ___ English.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be good at（擅长）。

questions.question: “He is afraid ___ the dark.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be afraid of（害怕）。

questions.question: “I look forward to ___ you.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 seeing。

questions.question: “He got up ___.” 表达“早”，应填入？
questions.explanation: early 本身可作副词（早），不加 -ly。

questions.question: “She sings ___.” 表达“好”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 sings 用副词 well；good 是形容词。

questions.question: “There is ___ water left.” 表达“几乎没有（否定）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: water 不可数，little 表“几乎没有”（否定）；a little 表“有一点”。

questions.question: “___ of the two answers is correct.” 表达“两个都（否定）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 两个中“都不对”用 neither；both 是“两个都”（肯定）。

questions.question: “___ he comes, I will go.” 表达“除非他不来”，应填入？
questions.explanation: unless = if not，表“除非”。

questions.question: “There are ___ books on the shelf.” 表达“许多（可数）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: books 可数复数，用 many 表“许多”。

questions.question: “He gave me ___ advice.” 表达“一些（不可数）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: advice 不可数，用 some 修饰。

questions.question: “___ rabbits like carrots.” 表达“大多数”，应填入？
questions.explanation: most 表“大多数”，后接复数名词 rabbits。

questions.question: “___ of the milk is fresh.” 表达“全部（不可数）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: milk 不可数，用 all 表“全部”；both 指两个。

questions.question: “I have two rabbits. ___ is white.” 表达“两个中的另一个”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 两者中的另一个用 the other。

questions.question: “Some like carrots, ___ like potatoes.” 表达“其它的（泛指）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 泛指“其它的（人/物）”作代词用 others。

questions.question: “This is ___ car.” 表达“我的（形容词性物主）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: car 前需要形容词性物主代词 my；mine 独立使用。

questions.question: “This car is ___.” 表达“我的（名词性物主）”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 表语位置、后面无名词，用名词性物主代词 mine。

questions.question: He is tall. 中 “tall” 是句子的什么成分？
questions.explanation: 系动词 is 后说明主语特征的成分为表语。

questions.question: Everyone ___ ready. 应填入？
questions.explanation: everyone/each 等作主语时谓语用单数。

questions.question: 被动语态的基本结构是？
questions.explanation: 被动语态由 be + 过去分词构成。

questions.question: “The carrot was eaten by the rabbit.” 是哪种语态？
questions.explanation: was eaten 是 be + 过去分词，动作承受者作主语，是被动语态。

questions.question: “Never have I seen such a carrot.” 是哪类倒装？
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 在句首，助动词 have 提前到主语前，是部分倒装。

questions.question: “It was the rabbit ___ ate the carrot.” 强调句应填入？
questions.explanation: 强调句型 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that 从句，一律用 that。

questions.question: “A number of rabbits ___ hopping.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: a number of + 复数 = “一些”，谓语用复数 are。

questions.question: “The number of rabbits ___ growing.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: the number of + 复数 = “…的数量”，中心词是 the number，谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: “Either you or he ___ going.” 就近一致，应填入？
questions.explanation: either...or 遵循就近一致，离谓语最近的是 he，用 is。

questions.question: “The rabbit, as well as other animals, ___ a carrot.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: as well as 不是并列主语，真正主语是 the rabbit，谓语用单数 gets。

questions.question: “The carrots were eaten by the rabbit.” 中主语是？
questions.explanation: 被动语态中动作承受者 the carrots 作主语。

questions.question: “The rabbit was seen to eat a carrot.” 被动语态中为什么 to 回来了？
options: 被动时感官动词后还原 to
questions.explanation: 感官动词 see + 裸不定式在主动态省略 to，变被动（be seen）时 to 要还原。

questions.question: “There is a carrot and two apples on the table.” 谓语 is 遵循？
questions.explanation: there be 遵循就近一致，最近的 a carrot 是单数，用 is。

questions.question: “Not only the rabbit but also many animals ___ carrots.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: not only...but also 就近一致，最近的 many animals 复数，用 like。

questions.question: “Every student and every teacher ___ here.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: every...and every... 强调个体，谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: “Here ___ the bus.” 完全倒装，应填入？
questions.explanation: Here/There 开头的完全倒装：谓语动词整体在主语前，主语 the bus 单数用 comes。

questions.question: “Never ___ I seen such a carrot.” 部分倒装，应填入？
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 开头部分倒装，助动词提前。现在完成时用 have。

questions.question: “It was yesterday ___ he left.” 强调时间，应填入？
questions.explanation: 强调句型 It was + 被强调部分 + that，即使强调时间也用 that 不用 when。

questions.question: “The rabbit was appointed ___ chairman.” 表唯一职位，应填入？
questions.explanation: 被任命为唯一职位（主席/队长等）时，名词前零冠词。

questions.question: “Not until midnight ___ the rabbit sleep.” 倒装，应填入？
questions.explanation: Not until 开头，主句部分倒装，一般过去时借助 did。

questions.question: “The carrots have been eaten.” 被动语态的时态是？
questions.explanation: have been eaten 是现在完成时的被动语态（have been + 过去分词）。

questions.question: “The rabbit was being watched.” 被动语态的时态是？
questions.explanation: was being watched 是过去进行时的被动语态（was being + 过去分词）。

questions.question: get-被动 “The rabbit got fired yesterday.” 表达？
questions.explanation: get + 过去分词表被动，常强调遭遇不愉快的事（被炒）。

questions.question: “This book ___ well.” 表“这本书卖得好”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 某些不及物动词（sell/wash/write）主动形式表被动意义：The book sells well。

questions.question: “___ a fine day, we went out.” 表达“天气好”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构：代词 + 现在分词（It being a fine day），作状语表原因。

questions.question: “The meeting ___ over, we left.” 表达“会议结束后”，应填入？
questions.explanation: 独立主格：名词 + 现在分词（meeting being over），表时间。

questions.question: “Each of the students ___ a book.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数 has。

questions.question: “Neither of them ___ correct.” 应填入？
questions.explanation: neither of + 复数，正式用法谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: “There ___ a pen and two books on the desk.” 就近一致，应填入？
questions.explanation: there be 就近一致，最近的 a pen 单数用 is。

questions.question: “It is I ___ am your friend.” 强调主语，应填入？
questions.explanation: 强调人作主语时，It is/was + 人 + who/that 从句（who 更强调人）。
